scope: Immediate admin sequence detail sheet, startup cost reduction, reversible HTTP compression comparison

behavior.opening: Open one modal from the typed summary before awaiting HTTP; start the scoped detail read after the first frame.
behavior.hydration: Mount the complete detail and its effects in the same route only after account, apparatus, row membership, epoch and revision validation.
behavior.unknown_fields: Static loading placeholders; no invented material, mold or production-map counts.
behavior.authority: Presentation-only summaries never authorize work. Full validated detail retains existing live revision synchronization.
behavior.retry: Visible below the header, reuses the same modal.
behavior.cancellation: A popped route rejects late replies even while its closing animation is mounted; an active temporarily covered route may finish hydration.
behavior.pending_reads: Close and explicit reopen share one pending scoped detail HTTP read, including while the list is awaiting live validation.

startup_costs.thumbnail: Seed the full sheet synchronously from fresh authorized RAM bytes using identical account/session/version/variant keys; do not copy an existing Uint8List.
startup_costs.thumbnail_expiry: RAM peek preserves existing freshness, rejects expired and future timestamps, and never waits for disk or network.
startup_costs.image_decode_limit: Preview uses the existing thumbnail provider; the full sheet uses MemoryImage. Reused encoded bytes do not guarantee eliminating a second codec decode across provider types.
startup_costs.hidden_reads_removed: Read-only admin viewers skip worker-only WIP start/resume candidates and scan-mold requirement requests.
startup_costs.visible_reads_preserved: Material and attached-mold counts remain loaded because their collapsed headers display the counts.
startup_costs.worker_path: Existing worker authorization and startup reads remain enabled.
startup_costs.loading_animation: Static placeholders; no repeating shimmer timer.

compression_decision.reason: Identity reduced debug localhost CPU time but sent approximately 3.9 to 5.3 times more body bytes and was slower in the 5 Mbps paced TCP comparison.
compression_decision.diagnostic_server_opt_in: compression=identity on compact admin sequence pages and explicitly requested single-order details

paced_tcp.label: SIMULATED_NETWORK_REAL_TCP
paced_tcp.algorithm: Buffer negotiated response, send chunks at absolute deadlines from cumulative body bytes and bandwidth; same algorithm for both modes.

cases.interpretation: Effectively tied; difference is timing noise.

compression_experiment.p95_reason: Harness records medians; individual timing arrays were not persisted.
limitations: Synthetic memory-store fixture and debug Rust build, not production or physical-phone measurements.
Body bytes exclude headers, TLS and packet overhead.
Pacing simulates bandwidth, not LTE latency, loss, radio behavior or congestion.
Timer resolution and concurrent machine activity affect small differences.
Paired modes use identical payloads; separate fixtures have slightly different principal/epoch sizes.
Sub-millisecond codec differences do not explain a one-second pre-open network wait.

widget_contracts: one modal route before and after hydration
no full detail or mutation controls before validated response
close before reply and reply during reverse animation
close and reopen share one pending GET
stale revision, epoch, account and selection guards
live sparse delta and row identity behavior
fresh thumbnail available at first full-detail build without another GET
hidden admin worker reads skipped and visible counts retained
verification.limitation: Physical-device responsiveness and long-duration multi-device stability require a build installed on those devices; these results do not claim that validation.
